mentions.name: Just for Today
mentions.description: A free, offline mindfulness app called Just for Today that invites users each morning to set a kind intention, check in with how they're feeling, practice gratitude, and write private reflections. It has no ads, no account, and all data stays on the user's device; it is inspired by a poem from How to Stop Worrying and Start Living.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building a mindfulness app to help people set daily intentions and practice gratitude — https://www.justfortoday.app/

It’s a free app called Just for Today, inspired by a poem I found in How to Stop Worrying and Start Living (amazing book).
